title: NavMorph: A Self-Evolving World Model for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
title_zh: NavMorph：面向连续环境视觉与语言导航的自进化世界模型
abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to execute sequential navigation actions in complex environments guided by natural language instructions. Current approaches often struggle with generalizing to novel environments and adapting to ongoing changes during navigation. Inspired by human cognition, we present NavMorph, a self-evolving world model framework that enhances environmental understanding and decision-making in VLN-CE. NavMorph employs compact latent representations to model environmental dynamics, equipping agents with foresight for adaptive planning and policy refinement. By integrating a novel Contextual Evolution Memory, NavMorph leverages scene-contextual information to support effective navigation while maintaining online adaptability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NavMorph achieves notable performance improvements on popular VLN-CE benchmarks. Our Code is available at https://github.com/Feliciaxyao/NavMorph.
abstract_zh: 连续环境中的视觉与语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体在复杂环境中根据自然语言指令执行顺序导航动作。当前方法通常难以泛化到新环境，并适应导航过程中的持续变化。受人类认知启发，我们提出了NavMorph，一种自进化世界模型框架，以增强VLN-CE中的环境理解和决策能力。NavMorph采用紧凑的潜在表示来建模环境动态，赋予智能体前瞻性，以进行自适应规划和策略细化。通过整合新颖的上下文演化记忆，NavMorph利用场景上下文信息支持有效导航，同时保持在线适应性。大量实验表明，NavMorph在流行的VLN-CE基准上取得了显著的性能提升。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Feliciaxyao/NavMorph 获取。
tldr_zh: NavMorph提出自进化世界模型，提升连续环境视觉语言导航的泛化与适应能力。
